UnitStatement: The mechanics verification benchmark crate provides original fixtures for OpenPipeStress using elementary open mechanics with invented numeric values; they are verification aids only and encode no code-specific acceptance criteria, protected standards content, or professional approval claims.
INTERNAL_ASSERTION_EPSILON is the internal assertion tolerance constant set to 1.0e-9 for floating-point comparisons in benchmark validation.
PKG09_FIXTURE_UNIT_SYSTEM_REF identifies the fixture unit system as "PKG09-FIXTURE-UNITS-EXPLICIT-N-M-RAD-K".

REQUIRED_READINESS_TBD_MARKERS enumerates readiness items that must remain TBD: final tolerance policy, release thresholds, CI gate policy, benchmark publication scope, external validation claims, and professional reliance.

FORBIDDEN_RELIANCE_CLAIM_MARKERS lists prohibited reliance phrases (e.g. "code compliant", "approved for professional reliance", "certified for professional reliance", "sealed engineering") that must not appear in benchmark text.

CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS defines the allowed physical dimension identifiers for expected values, including length, mass, force, moment, pressure, stress, rotation, thermal_expansion_coefficient, second_moment_area, section_modulus, and TBD.

BenchmarkFamily enum classifies fixtures into families: Cantilever, Frame, StraightPipe, SupportBoundary, PrimitiveLoad, IntegratedLinearStatic, LoadToResultantIntegration, ThermalGrowth, ImposedDisplacement, and StiffnessTransform.
RedistributionStatus enum has the single variant PublicOriginal, marking fixtures as project-original public content.
ReviewDisposition enum has the single variant AcceptedInventedFixture, marking fixtures as reviewed and accepted as invented.
BenchmarkProvenance struct records fixture provenance: source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_disposition.

BenchmarkProvenance::public_original constructs provenance with source_name "OpenPipeStress original mechanics benchmark", license "project-original-public-content", and a certification that content was generated from elementary open mechanics and not copied from protected standards, commercial software examples, or proprietary data.

BenchmarkProvenance::is_publicly_usable returns true only when redistribution_status is PublicOriginal, review_disposition is AcceptedInventedFixture, name/location/license are non-empty, and the certification contains "not copied from protected standards".

FixtureUnitBasis struct records explicit fixture-local unit identifiers for length, force, moment, stress, area, second_moment_area, section_modulus, linear_stiffness, mass_per_length, acceleration, rotation, temperature_interval, dimensionless, and distributed load.

FixtureUnitBasis::is_explicit_fixture_basis returns true only when unit_system_ref equals PKG09_FIXTURE_UNIT_SYSTEM_REF, status is "fixture-local-explicit-units-no-conversions", core unit fields are non-empty, and the note states the unit catalog remains TBD.

FIXTURE_UNIT_BASIS constant fixes fixture units as length=m, force=N, moment=N-m, stress=Pa, area=m^2, second_moment_area=m^4, section_modulus=m^3, linear_stiffness=N/m, mass_per_length=kg/m, acceleration=m/s^2, rotation=rad, temperature_interval=K; explicit fixture-local units only with no conversion constants and project unit catalog remaining TBD.
ExpectedValue struct holds a named expected result: name, value (f64), unit, dimension, and an optional tolerance_policy.
MechanicsBenchmark struct aggregates a fixture: fixture_id, family, description, assumptions, provenance, unit_basis, and expected_values.
MechanicsBenchmark::tolerance_policy_is_unresolved returns true when every expected value has no tolerance_policy (all None), reflecting the unresolved tolerance policy.

MechanicsBenchmark::has_dimensioned_expected_values returns true when every expected value is finite, has a non-empty unit, and a dimension in CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS, and the unit basis is an explicit fixture basis.
LinearStaticIntegrationResult struct captures node-1 UX/UY/UZ displacements, lumped node UY forces, and recovered local axial force and shear at node j.
LoadToResultantIntegrationResult struct captures node-1 UY displacement and RZ rotation, assembled node-0 UY force and RZ moment, and midspan shear-y and bending-z.
OrientedLoadToResultantIntegrationResult struct captures node-1 UX displacement and RZ rotation, assembled node-0 UX force and RZ moment, and midspan shear-y and bending-z.
PartialSpanLoadToResultantIntegrationResult struct captures node-1 UY displacement and RZ rotation, assembled node-0 and node-1 UY forces and RZ moments, and midspan shear-y and bending-z.
StationSweepResultant struct holds a station_fraction with its shear_y and bending_z resultants.
StationSweepResultantIntegrationResult struct holds a vector of StationSweepResultant station resultants.
AxialEffectStationResultant struct holds a station_fraction with axial_force, shear_y, and bending_z.

ThermalPressureAxialEffectsResult struct captures thermal axial force, pressure thrust force, total axial effect force, equivalent node-i/j axial loads, recovered local i/j axial forces, end and midspan axial forces, and a station sweep.

CombinedLoadAxialEffectsResult struct captures thermal/pressure/total axial effect forces, assembled nodal forces and moments, node-1 displacements and rotation, end-i and midspan resultants, a station sweep, and distributed and axial-effect recovery hook counts.

CanonicalAnalyticalPayloadSolverResult struct captures distributed-load and point-force counts, y_reference vector, assembled nodal forces/moments, support reactions, node-1 displacement and rotation, midspan resultants, recovery hook counts, and load-vector trace chains.
CanonicalResultTraceChain struct pairs a result_id with its trace_chain of ResultTraceLink entries.
CanonicalSolveResultEnvelopeEvidence struct captures a ResultEnvelope plus export-validation diagnostic count, quantity-result count, and envelope diagnostic count.

fixture_inventory() returns the complete vector of mechanics benchmark fixtures (17 fixtures spanning cantilever, frame, straight-pipe, thermal, support-boundary, primitive-load, and TP-PHYS integration fixtures).
fixture_inventory_ids() returns the list of fixture_id strings for all mechanics benchmarks.
readiness_boundaries_are_documented() validates that documented readiness boundaries are present (required TBD markers documented).
contains_forbidden_reliance_claim(text) returns true if the text contains any FORBIDDEN_RELIANCE_CLAIM_MARKERS phrase after whitespace normalization.
contains_normalized_marker(text, marker) checks whether a normalized marker phrase occurs in normalized text.
normalize_whitespace(text) collapses whitespace into a single-space normalized string for marker matching.
missing_required_families(fixtures) returns the list of required BenchmarkFamily values not covered by the supplied fixtures.

cantilever_tip_force_fixture defines MECH-CANTILEVER-TIP-FORCE: a two-node Euler-Bernoulli cantilever with invented lateral tip force; tip_displacement_y = tip_force*length^3/(3*E*I) and fixed_end_moment_z = tip_force*length (length=10, E=1200, I=4, tip_force=6).
portal_frame_sway_fixture defines MECH-PORTAL-SWAY-ORIGINAL: an original two-column portal-frame assembly used as a deterministic frame-assembly smoke benchmark.

fixed_fixed_thermal_fixture defines MECH-FIXED-FIXED-THERMAL-AXIAL: a fixed-fixed axial member with free_thermal_strain=alpha*delta_T and restrained_axial_force=E*A*alpha*delta_T (E=2000, A=3, alpha=1.2e-5, delta_T=75), following open mechanics EA*alpha*delta_T.
tp_phys_008_thermal_pressure_axial_effects_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-008-THERMAL-PRESSURE-AXIAL-EFFECTS for thermal and pressure axial-effect preparation and recovery.
tp_phys_009_combined_load_axial_effects_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-009-COMBINED-LOAD-AXIAL-EFFECTS for combined load assembly, solving, and axial-effect recovery.
tp_phys_014_canonical_analytical_payload_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-014-CANONICAL-ANALYTICAL-PAYLOAD driving solver consumption from a canonical analytical payload.
tp_phys_015a_canonical_solve_result_envelope_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-015-CANONICAL-SOLVE-RESULT-ENVELOPE producing canonical solve result-envelope evidence.

straight_pipe_weight_recovery_fixture defines MECH-STRAIGHT-PIPE-WEIGHT-RECOVERY: weight_force_per_length = mass_per_length*gravity (2.5*9.0=22.5) with local axial recovery following EA*delta/L for a two-node straight member.
support_boundary_fixture defines MECH-SUPPORT-BOUNDARY-MIXED for mixed support-boundary preparation.
primitive_load_preparation_fixture defines MECH-PRIMITIVE-LOAD-PREP exercising all primitive-load contribution types.
tp_phys_002_linear_static_integration_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-002-LINEAR-STATIC-INTEGRATION for integrated linear-static solve, recovery, and diagnostic mapping.
tp_phys_004_load_to_resultant_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-004-LOAD-TO-RESULTANT for load assembly, solving, and resultant recovery.
tp_phys_005_oriented_load_to_resultant_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-005-ORIENTED-LOAD-TO-RESULTANT transforming oriented global loads to resultants.
tp_phys_006_partial_span_load_to_resultant_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-006-PARTIAL-SPAN-LOAD-TO-RESULTANT routing spanned (partial-span) loads to resultants.
tp_phys_007_station_sweep_resultants_fixture defines MECH-TP-PHYS-007-STATION-SWEEP-RESULTANTS preserving requested station order and values.
imposed_displacement_spring_fixture defines a fixture (ImposedDisplacement family) preparing an imposed-displacement support boundary with a spring.
inclined_member_transform_fixture defines an inclined-member stiffness-transform fixture checking direction cosines and stiffness-matrix symmetry.

A #[cfg(test)] test module exercises the fixtures: inventory coverage, provenance, readiness metadata, and per-fixture solve/validate behavior.
Test inventory_covers_required_mechanics_families asserts no required families are missing, the inventory holds exactly 17 fixtures, and key TP-PHYS fixtures (007, 008, 009, 014, 015) are present.
Test fixture_provenance_is_public_original_and_reviewed asserts every fixture has publicly-usable provenance, an unresolved tolerance policy, and dimensioned expected values.

Test readiness_metadata_matches_documented_boundaries asserts fixture IDs are unique, readiness boundaries are documented, each fixture_id appears in the benchmark README and the hand-calculation README, and each fixture's unit basis equals FIXTURE_UNIT_BASIS.
Test cantilever_tip_force_matches_open_mechanics_formula asserts the solved tip displacement matches the fixture expected value within INTERNAL_ASSERTION_EPSILON.
Test thermal_growth_fixture_records_open_axial_restraint_formula asserts free_thermal_strain=0.0009 and restrained axial force=5.4 within tolerance.

The nonlinear benchmark crate is named open_pipe_stress_nonlinear_benchmarks (version 0.1.0, edition 2021), described as original nonlinear support regression benchmarks for OpenPipeStress, and is not published.
The nonlinear benchmark crate depends on the local linear_supports, nonlinear_supports, and solver diagnostics core solver crates.
The nonlinear crate contains invented nonlinear support regression fixtures for active-set, gap, lift-off, friction, and non-convergence behavior.

The nonlinear fixtures are software verification aids only; they do not encode protected standards examples, real project data, proprietary benchmark outputs, engineering acceptance criteria, or authority claims.
Nonlinear fixture values carry explicit unit identifiers under PKG09-NONLINEAR-FIXTURE-UNITS-EXPLICIT-MM-N-NM, a fixture-local basis recording units for evidence review only.

The nonlinear fixture unit basis does not define project conversion constants or the canonical unit catalog, which remain TBD; hand-calculation and provenance notes live in validation/hand_calcs/nonlinear/.
